svg.title: CAN bus on two breadboards: sender and receiver
svg.desc: Two ESP32-C3 SuperMini boards, each with a WCMCU-230. Both ESPs are powered separately via USB. Connect 3V3 to 3V3, GND to GND, GPIO5 to CTX and GPIO4 to CRX. CANH, CANL and GND connect the nodes. The WCMCU-230 modules provide built-in bus termination; no external resistors are needed. Components and pin positions are schematic.
svg.text: Wiring diagram: components and pin positions are schematic. Follow the pin labels on the actual board.
USB powers ESP → ESP powers CAN module at 3.3 V
USB powers ESP → ESP powers CAN module at 3.3 V
CANH ↔ CANH · CANL ↔ CANL · GND ↔ GND
Twist CANH and CANL for longer connections.
Power both ESPs separately via USB; no 5V/3V3 jumper.
WCMCU-230 modules have built-in bus termination.
No additional external resistors are needed.
With power off, measure CANH to CANL: total ≈ 60 Ω.
Source: repository README / GPIO configuration · SN65HVD230: TI datasheet · Power CAN modules at 3.3 V only.
